forgejo-operator has been installed.

This chart requires cert-manager to already be present in the cluster (it
issues the webhook's TLS certificate). If the manager pod is stuck waiting
on the "webhook-server-cert" Secret, that's why.

Verify:

  kubectl get pods -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  kubectl get crds | grep forgejo.schranke.de

Next, create a Forgejo resource pointing at your Forgejo instance's URL and
credentials Secret — see config/samples/v1alpha1_forgejo.yaml for an
example.
